review.note: Approved (agent-e0a3, W9 reviewer r3). Fresh runs (serial lock): cd src-tauri && cargo check --offline -> 0; cargo check --offline --features native-smoke -> 0; cargo test --offline sysfonts -> 4 passed, 0 failed; no warnings, no downloads; npx vitest run src/fonts/system.test.ts -> 7/7; npx tsc -b exit 0. Minor, not blocking: the 30 MB limit is checked after reading the whole file (std::fs::read then len); a metadata check first would avoid reading a huge file. Three unsafe calls (symbolic_traits, attribute, post_script_name) lack SAFETY comments. Native app UI and export with an installed font are unverified: owner hand check in notes/C6.md.
